operation: Q4_K and Q6_K single-column quantized matrix-vector multiply
extended_expert_opt_in: V200_EXTENDED_EXPERT_COMPUTE=1 enables Q6_K expert banks and Q4_K expert banks with 768 through 2047 columns; existing Q4_K banks at 2048 or more columns retain their default route.

scope.fusion: plain or gate-only fusion for expert-indexed banks
scope.small_k: Both false and true are recognized; the target 768-column expert-down banks use true on V100.
scope.rows_per_grid_block: 1 for regular K; 4 for the recognized small-K family.

grid_contract.y: 1 for plain row routing; >1 for expert-indexed routing

placement.required_memory: V200 pair-managed VMM allocations accessible on both owners
placement.plain_single_owner: submit all rows to the physical owner of the weight extent
placement.plain_two_owner: split at the published first-extent boundary, rounded up to a complete row
placement.extent_order: Use V200_ALLOCATION_INFO_FLAG_FIRST_EXTENT_OWNER_*; never infer the first owner from default placement
placement.unrecognized_or_unsupported: forward unchanged to the original anchor launch

expert_owner_routing.shape: grid.y > 1, grid.z = 1, single-column decode, ncols_x >= 2048 by default; opt-in lowers the expert-bank minimum to 768 columns
expert_owner_routing.placement: Route the unchanged full grid to the owner of the complete expert weight bank; gate-fused weights must share that owner
expert_owner_routing.active_weight_bytes: min(grid.x * rows_per_grid_block, stride_col_dst) * grid.y * quantized row_bytes; Q4_K uses 144 bytes per 256 columns and Q6_K uses 210
expert_owner_routing.minimum_peer_work_estimate: 4 MiB active weights plus the bounded activation and output byte spans
expert_owner_routing.threshold_basis: Conservative initial policy informed by existing atlas event and NVLink measurements; the 4 MiB cutoff is an estimate, not a measured crossover for this operator bridge
expert_owner_routing.expert_ids: Remain GPU-resident and unchanged; the hook does not copy IDs or specialize their values

numerical_contract: Each output row executes the original pinned llama Q4_K or Q6_K kernel exactly once; no floating-point reduction is split or reordered.

verification.behavior: On the first plain peer-owner and split route, and independently for the first peer-owner plain-expert and gate-fused-expert family for each quant type, run an anchor reference then compare the routed output bitwise.
verification.diagnostics: V200_PROFILE_LOG receives v200-operator-ledger/v1 route and process-exit records, including Q4_K extended-column and per-family peer/verification counters plus separate Q6_K expert-family counters, alongside frontdoor memory snapshots.

fallbacks: grid.z is not one, or channel/index shape is unsupported
unsupported fusion, batched, or multi-column specialization
input, output, or weight range is not fully pair-managed
weight ownership cannot be proven from the contiguous VMM extent record
the complete weight range is anchor-owned
